validation_rules.name: data_object_only_when_query_or_mutate
validation_rules.message: A data_object_id may only be set when operation_kind is query or mutate.
validation_rules.description: side_effect and compute tools have no business-data return value; the FK is meaningless for them and must stay null.

validation_rules.name: data_object_required_when_query_or_mutate
validation_rules.message: A data_object_id is required when operation_kind is query or mutate.
validation_rules.description: Pairs with data_object_only_when_query_or_mutate. query and mutate tools must name the data_object they read or write so the 100% Semantius derivation can resolve solution coverage.

validation_rules.name: platform_coverage_when_query_or_mutate
validation_rules.message: coverage_tier must be 'platform' when operation_kind is query or mutate.
validation_rules.description: query and mutate tools operate against a Semantius-mastered data_object (enforced by data_object_required_when_query_or_mutate). Only the platform can serve queries/mutates against its own data_objects; external/integration coverage is incoherent for this operation_kind.
